# ATM Companion architecture

The current architecture is in [M3-ARCHITECTURE.md](M3-ARCHITECTURE.md): staged recipe knowledge, bounded material alternatives and observations for one vanilla crafting/cooking operation. [M2-ARCHITECTURE.md](M2-ARCHITECTURE.md) records the earlier material-planning and quest integration design.

M1 raw snapshots retain schema 1; current recipe indexes and planning reports use schema 2. See [VERIFICATION.md](VERIFICATION.md) for tested scope. Earlier release bundles preserve their original source and documentation.
